title: FutureCombiner
description: A texture pack that replaces modded block textures with their future counterparts. Like cherry trees in biomes o plenty, or bamboo panks from bambooblocks
body:
A texture pack that replaces modded block textures with their future counterparts. Like cherry trees in biomes o plenty, or bamboo panks from bambooblocks.

Currently supported mods are Quark, BambooBlocks, and BiomesoPlenty
